permitted_source_command.source: Case-owned emit.py writes only the bytes of case-owned items.txt to stdout. No input interpolation, shell variables, network, or user files.

permitted_source_command.environment: Explicit PATH and temporary isolated HOME/TEMP; inherited system-root values only when present. SKIM_* ambient variables are not inherited.
